fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding/swing metal gate across the truck driveway through a tall wrought-iron perimeter fence on the Owensmouth Ave (east) frontage, seen in Jan-2026 Street View at ~34.2373,-118.6024.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure beside the gate - the entrance is just a gate in the fence line.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present with a small call-box/intercom post beside it and no guard shack - remote/kiosk-style check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Recessed dock doors face the fenced east yard inside the perimeter; ~6 estimated, partly obscured by roof overhang and trees - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated drop lot; a couple of box trucks/trailers seen in the alley and yard - small capacity.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The fenced east yard inside the gate functions as a small paved holding/dock-approach area before the doors.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense San Fernando Valley industrial park, Chatsworth - clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box - constrained urban legacy parcel, ~4-5 acres including building footprint and surface parking.
